files.title: Import margin, daily
files.description: Landed cost of 62% fines (C5 and C3 voyages) and the Dalian 45-day 62% equivalent, with every bridge component, the margin against the most-active contract, modeled freight with bands and netbacks. CFR proxy: SGX iron ore futures at a 45-day horizon.

files.title: Import margin, monthly baseline
files.description: Same chain on the IMF 62% Fe CFR China monthly average against the monthly average of the daily Dalian 45-day price, with World Bank CFR for comparison, freight shares and netbacks.

files.title: Modeled Capesize freight, daily
files.description: C3 and C5 voyage model and regression estimates with 80% error bands, the BCI, Brent, the time charter and bunker proxies. Modeled series, not published route rates.

files.title: Steel mill futures margin, daily
files.description: Rebar and HRC futures margins (most-active and same-delivery-month contracts) with the ore, coke and other-cost components.

files.title: Dalian iron ore curve, daily
files.description: Constant-maturity 30, 45, 60 and 90-day prices on a 62% Fe basis with the method and contracts used, the most-active contract and total open interest.

files.title: Dalian grade premium X
files.description: Fe premium per 0.1% computed from the exchange rule for each half-year window, used to put 61% contracts on a 62% basis.

files.title: China iron ore imports, monthly
files.description: Iron ores and concentrates, million tonnes, from the China Customs (GACC) English monthly bulletins, with the table and URL of each month. January and February 2020 were published together; September and October 2024 and the latest month come from the preliminary release.

files.title: Validation anchors: published route rates
files.description: Dated C3 and C5 assessments with the assessor, the publication that reported them, the URL and a quote.

files.title: Calibration pairs: BCI and time charter
files.description: Dated pairs of BCI points and the Capesize time charter average used to calibrate the TCE proxy.

files.title: Calibration points: bunker prices
files.description: Dated Singapore HSFO and VLSFO prices used to map Brent to the bunker price.
